la Dreta de l'Eixample — Barcelona, Spain

Average day Average night

In detail

Genuine property-crime risk documented here: a €500,000 Richard Mille watch was snatched from a tourist on Passeig de Gràcia in December 2023 by an organized scooter gang (3Cat), and Mossos' specialist anti-watch-robbery unit has repeatedly targeted this area. Tourist apartments are also a specific burglary target — Mossos arrested one man for 51 break-ins into holiday flats across Eixample and Sant Martí. Betevé (Feb 2024) also reported heavy resident complaints about all-night tourist-flat parties — an incivility issue more than a threat to visitor safety. No evidence found of violent street crime against pedestrians specifically in this barri. Sources checked: 3Cat; Govern.cat (Mossos press release); Betevé, Feb 2024.
